operation.reason: The fresh prediction and the completed mapped Cα fit establish paired coverage and structural discrepancy for the supplied Top7 fragment.
unresolved: Individual residue deviations, side-chain conformations and the unobserved termini lie outside this global Cα comparison.
One fixed-seed prediction leaves run-to-run variation unmeasured. Top7 predates the model training cutoff, so training exposure is possible and performance on unseen proteins remains open.

scientific_decision.rationale: The approved AlphaFold prediction supplied the coordinates used in agreement.json. The equal-weight, proper-rotation fit used {{metric:matched_positions}} of {{metric:mapped_positions}} mapped Cα pairs and gave an RMSD of {{metric:calpha_rmsd_A}}. The matched-pair list reproduces the supplied map, including the methionine–selenomethionine pair identified in the inventory and confirmed in both coordinate files. This answers the calibration question over the entire intended fragment.

scientific_scope: Calibration on one published archival specimen with possible training exposure; independent numerics use the same experimental deposition.
